title: FAI Orchard Discovery Queries
description: The GitHub Search API queries the Orchard crawler runs to discover candidate Accelerators per Variety. Read by `discover.js` (Phase [A1.1]) alongside `seed-list.json`. Each query is independently disable-able. Schema is CC0-1.0.
$comment: License: CC0-1.0 (Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal — public domain dedication). SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0. Authored by FrootAI 2026-05-25 as part of Phase [A0.26] of the FAI Orchard master plan.

$schema.description: Optional URL of the schema this document validates against.

schema_version.description: Strict semver. v1.0.0 is the initial release.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. When the file was last regenerated or hand-edited.

queries.description: Ordered list of GitHub Search queries the crawler runs. Order is non-significant (each query produces a candidate set; union is deduped against seed-list.json in `[A1.2]`).

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier (so the crawler can log per-query results and we can disable individual queries by id).

variety.description: Which Variety this query feeds. Matches the variety enum in fai-accelerator.schema.json.

query.description: GitHub Search API query string. See https://docs.github.com/en/search-github/searching-on-github/searching-for-repositories

min_stars.description: Minimum stars filter applied after the query returns. Default 50 if absent.

max_results.description: How many results to fetch per query. GitHub Search API caps at 1000. Default 100 if absent.

reason.description: Why this query exists — what gap it covers vs the seed list.

enabled.description: If false, the crawler skips this query. Default true.

added_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. When this query was added to the registry.
